answer: A strong defense is stake-linked reputation that grows only through verified work: each identity must lock a deposit and earn trust slowly from completed, checkable tasks. A fake swarm then faces a real cost, because every copy needs its own deposit and its own history, while honest agents send a clear signal of reliability. Like pigment that cannot be faked without the raw material, or ivory that reveals its origin under inspection, a reputation built from scarce stake and time cannot be mass-produced cheaply, so Sybil creation stops scaling.
